title: Regression suite to prevent quality regressions
description: Added regression script that validates similarity/wer/click metrics against thresholds.

title: Vevo live: polish client/server UX
description: Add clearer CLI docs for port forwarding and audio device selection; consider server-side backpressure/queue and optional limiter/AGC smoothing.

title: Live buffered Vevo conversion: mic -> buffer -> inference -> playback
description: Implemented buffered live pipeline via websocket server (GPU) + local client (mic/playback) with window/hop buffering, length normalization, and boundary crossfades.

title: Paper-comparable eval vs StyleStream (WER/S-SIM/A-SIM/E-SIM)
description: Add an evaluation mode that matches StyleStream paper objective metrics: Whisper-large-v3 WER vs transcript, Resemblyzer speaker similarity, accent similarity via Jzuluaga accent-id ecapa, emotion similarity via emotion2vec, plus deterministic StyleStream-like dataset subset + report.

title: Vevo live: improve eval efficiency + content metric
description: Cache speaker/ASR models during search, avoid per-config reloads, and improve content-preservation metric (Whisper WER robustness; consider language forcing/VAD/ASR confidence).

title: Deterministic evaluation harness + autotune for Vevo VC
description: Added deterministic streaming simulation + grid search autotune harness and best-config artifact outputs.

title: Vevo wrapper: offline WAV->WAV conversion CLI
description: Add a standalone CLI entrypoint that runs Amphion's official Vevo inference to convert an input audio file (source) into the target speaker/style defined by a reference clip. Must support vevovoice and vevotimbre checkpoints/configs and write an output WAV deterministically.

title: Vast.ai workflow: git sync + run scripts for inference/eval
description: Added scripts/vast/* for venv setup, git pull, offline smoke, live server, and autotune on RTX 4090 host.
